clips.title: The story
paras: On Loch Modan’s southeastern shore, Bingles Blastenheimer waits beside the wreck of his flying machine. Stranded among troggs and beasts, the gnomish aviator needs his tools and parts back.

Bingles Blastenheimer took his customized flying craft into the skies, but bringing it down safely proved harder than lifting off. His gyrocopter malfunctioned and crashed on the Loch’s southeastern shore. Bingles survived, but the machine broke apart. Far from Ironforge, he stays near the wreck, wary of hungry crocolisks and hostile troggs. Troggs from a nearby island stole his tools and Blastencapper explosives, and he asks passing travelers to recover them.
